html:
Services

General Practice

  • General consultations (by appointment)
  • Chronic disease management plans
  • Annual health assessments (eligible patients)
  • Minor procedures: wound care, skin lesion removal

Telehealth

Telehealth consultations are available to patients who attended in person within the last twelve months. Telehealth availability depends on practitioner rostering and is confirmed at booking time.

Pathology collection

An independent pathology collector attends our premises for specimen collection ordered by your doctor. Collection hours are listed on our contact page.
